added.summary: `writing-vertical-rl` lays a `<Text>` (or a paragraph) out in columns, CSS's `writing-mode: vertical-rl` with upright glyphs: lines break at the box's height, the first column is on the right, and CJK punctuation takes its vertical forms. Selection and hits follow the columns; `writing-horizontal-tb` turns it back. Inputs stay horizontal; decoration lines and ruby are not drawn in columns yet.
